tweakercontainer.gui.title: TweakerContainer Configs
Master switch for all automatic highlighting
Show the outlines while holding this item, as an item ID such as minecraft:shulker_box
Draw the outlines through blocks

While holding the trigger item, right-clicking a container just registers it and keeps the screen closed when the contents can be fetched from the server (built-in server in single player, Servux or the vanilla query on a server)
tweakercontainer.config.generic.name.sup: Also Keep The Projection Container Closed
The projection container stays openable by default so you can put materials in; enable this to keep that one closed as well
Draw the projection container's outline even when the trigger item is not held; off by default, so the outline only shows while holding the trigger item
SINGLE: right-clicking a container replaces the previous pick. MULTI: right-click adds one, right-click again removes it (corner-point mode comes in the next version)

Where the container contents come from.
AUTO: read the built-in server in single player, ask the server when connected (the server needs Servux)
INTEGRATED: only read the built-in server
SERVUX: only ask the server
SCREEN: only use the contents you have opened
How often (in ticks) the contents of nearby marked containers are fetched again, so changes made by other players show up. 20 ticks = 1 second, 0 disables the refresh

How many containers are polled per refresh round (they rotate, not all at once). Reading the built-in server in single player / on a LAN host is cheap so a larger value is fine; on a server the ceiling is the Servux channel's in-flight limit of 32
Items with different components do not count as available and cannot substitute for each other
Under strict NBT, give slots whose item matches but whose components differ a different background colour
Shulker boxes and bundles inside containers also count as available items, up to two levels deep
Annotate only the first matching slot per item type, leaving the other slots untouched; disable to annotate every matching slot
Spread the required amount across slots, up to one stack each; disable to show the whole amount on the first matching slot
Also spread the amount across slots for non-stackable items; disabled by default, so a single slot shows the whole amount
Also show the projection container shortage hints in the player inventory screen
Horizontal offset of the shortage count text from the slot's top left corner, in pixels
Vertical offset of the shortage count text from the slot's top left corner, in pixels
Font scale of the shortage count text
Hotkey to open this configuration screen
